highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews the Skia m156 renderer with GTK4 GPU rendering and updated platform assets.
highlights_body: It restores Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies deployments and aligns native packages with current .NET, Windows, and Tizen toolchains.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Skia m156 and integrates the remaining m155 core-fork cleanup.
Adds native GPU rendering and pixel scaling for GTK4 applications.
NoDependencies deployments on Linux can again discover installed system fonts.

bullets.lead: Native assets align with current platforms
bullets.detail: Updates WebAssembly assets for .NET 11 previews, restores the WinUI Windows SDK default, and packages Tizen builds with GCC 14.2.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies deployments and contributed platform packaging improvements
contributor_summaries.VirgilMing: Bound bundled HarfBuzz functions locally on Linux and stabilized Blazor sample test startup
contributor_summaries.dalexsoto: Addressed contextual policy findings in continuous integration
contributor_summaries.Saad-elnagar: Removed an obsolete libmicrohttpd attribution notice

preview_summaries.v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10: Preview 1 introduces the Skia m156 engine, GTK4 GPU rendering, restored Linux system-font discovery, and refreshed native platform assets.

harfbuzz_summary: Aligns HarfBuzzSharp native assets with the .NET 11 preview, current Windows toolchain, and Tizen GCC 14.2 builds.
